data.gender_notes: Nuwwarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A delicate flower that blooms in the desert, symbolizing hope and resilience. data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuwwarah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
